title: Treaty of Bromberg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Bromberg", at revision 1381665101, opens: "The Treaty of Bromberg or Treaty of Bydgoszcz was a treaty between John II Casimir Vasa and Elector Frederick William of Brandenburg-Prussia that was ratified at Bromberg (Bydgoszcz) on 6 November 1657. The treaty had several agreements, including the Treaty of Wehlau, signed on 19 September 1657 by the Brandenburg–Prussian and Polish–Lithuanian envoys in Wehlau. Thus, the Treaty of Bromberg is sometimes referred to as treaty of Wehlau-Bromberg or Treaty of Wehlau and Bromberg." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q688969, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1657 alliance between Poland–Lithuania and Brandenburg". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
